keys: 从左边的仪器架点一台仪器,它会落在织案中央
zh: 从左边的仪器架点一台仪器,它会落在织案中央
en: Pick an instrument from the rack on the left; it lands in the middle of the loom bench

en: Drag a thread out from a spool or an instrument's outlet and plug it into the next instrument or the Goal Loom

keys: 给本口的自由纹样赋值(求解只看输入和钉住的纹样,不从下游反推)
zh: 给本口的自由纹样赋值(求解只看输入和钉住的纹样,不从下游反推)
en: Pin a pattern on this free port (the loom only reads inputs and pinned patterns, never works backwards from below)

keys: 纹样还有未染纱(不能包含 ? 元变量)
zh: 纹样还有未染纱(不能包含 ? 元变量)
en: The pattern still has undyed yarn
Ply: split into left and right halves
Layer: split into upper and lower layers

keys: 接入小机(拉起桥接与语音助手)
zh: 接入小机(拉起桥接与语音助手)
en: Connect Bobbin (start bridge and voice assistant)

keys: 小机声音:改音色 / 音量 / 台词(中文一行、英文一行),先「保存并生成语音」(需联网),再「刷入固件与语音」送进小机
zh: 小机声音:改音色 / 音量 / 台词(中文一行、英文一行),先「保存并生成语音」(需联网),再「刷入固件与语音」送进小机
en: Bobbin's voice: change the voices, volume and lines (one Chinese row, one English row), then "Save and generate voices" (needs internet), then "Flash firmware and voices" to send them to Bobbin

keys: 校准「看电脑方向」:自动 = 小机左右张望,正对屏幕时朝它挥手(或按它的 BOOT 键);手动 = 微调后保存。
zh: 校准「看电脑方向」:自动 = 小机左右张望,正对屏幕时朝它挥手(或按它的 BOOT 键);手动 = 微调后保存。
en: Calibrate "facing the screen": auto = Bobbin looks left and right, wave at it (or press its BOOT key) when it faces the screen; manual = nudge, then save.

zh: 串口 / 小机:离线(没插 USB,或桥接还没找到 /dev/cu.usbmodem*)
en: Serial / Bobbin: offline (USB not plugged in, or the bridge has not found /dev/cu.usbmodem* yet)
